meaning: to spread; to be passed down (stories, sayings, rumors)

senses.en: to spread; to be passed down (stories, sayings, rumors)

note: Used for things that circulate among people over time: stories, songs, rumors.

examples.zh: 这个故事在我们村流传了很多年。
examples.en: This story has been passed down in our village for many years.

examples.zh: 网上流传着一个不对的消息。
examples.en: A false piece of news is going around online.

examples.zh: 这首歌现在还在年轻人中间流传吗？
examples.en: Is this song still popular among young people?

meaning: to consult; to use as a reference; reference

senses.en: to consult; to use as a reference; reference

note: 供你参考 = for your reference; 参考 + 意见/资料 is common.

examples.zh: 这是我的想法，你可以参考。
examples.en: This is my idea; you can use it as a reference.

examples.zh: 写论文时，我参考了很多书。
examples.en: When I wrote my paper, I consulted many books.

examples.zh: 这些价格只能参考，不一定对。
examples.en: These prices are for reference only; they may not be right.

note: 受到称赞 = to be praised; 称赞 + person + 很 + adj.

examples.zh: 老师称赞她的汉语说得很好。
examples.en: The teacher praised her for speaking Chinese so well.

examples.zh: 大家都称赞他做的菜好吃。
examples.en: Everyone complimented his cooking.

examples.zh: 你为什么不称赞孩子呢？
examples.en: Why don't you praise the child?

note: 做体操 = do exercises (e.g. morning exercises); 体操比赛 = a gymnastics competition.

examples.zh: 我女儿每周去学体操。
examples.en: My daughter goes to gymnastics class every week.

examples.zh: 早上公园里有很多人在做体操。
examples.en: In the morning many people do exercises in the park.

examples.zh: 昨天晚上我看了体操比赛。
examples.en: Last night I watched a gymnastics competition.

note: Also 家 for a branch: 一家邮局.

examples.zh: 请问，附近有邮局吗？
examples.en: Excuse me, is there a post office nearby?

examples.zh: 我要去邮局寄一个包裹。
examples.en: I need to go to the post office to send a package.

examples.zh: 邮局下午五点就关了，我们快走吧。
examples.en: The post office closes at five; let's hurry.

meaning: within; inside (a limit of time, distance, or amount)

senses.en: within; inside (a limit of time, distance, or amount)

note: Goes after the number: 三天以内 = within three days.

examples.zh: 请在三天以内回复我。
examples.en: Please reply to me within three days.

examples.zh: 这家饭店离地铁站一公里以内。
examples.en: This hotel is within one kilometer of the subway station.

examples.zh: 我想花的钱在五百元以内。
examples.en: I want to spend no more than 500 yuan.

note: Jade is a traditional gift and charm in China; also in names (e.g. 玉米 corn).

examples.zh: 这块玉是我奶奶给我的。
examples.en: This piece of jade was given to me by my grandmother.

examples.zh: 中国人很喜欢戴玉。
examples.en: Chinese people like to wear jade.

examples.zh: 你能看出来这是真玉吗？
examples.en: Can you tell whether this is real jade?

note: 跟上潮流 = keep up with the trend; 时尚潮流 = fashion trend.

examples.zh: 年轻人总是喜欢跟着潮流走。
examples.en: Young people tend to follow trends.

examples.zh: 我不太懂现在的潮流。
examples.en: I don't really understand today's trends.

examples.zh: 这些衣服是今年最新的潮流。
examples.en: These clothes are this year's latest trend.

meaning: to waver; to shake (a belief or decision)

senses.en: to waver; to shake (a belief or decision)

note: 不动摇 = firm; usually about decisions, beliefs, or confidence.

examples.zh: 他的决定一直没有动摇。
examples.en: His decision has never wavered.

examples.zh: 别人怎么说，我都不会动摇。
examples.en: No matter what others say, I won't waver.

examples.zh: 这次失败动摇了他的信心。
examples.en: This failure shook his confidence.

note: In daily life mostly 汇款 (remit money) and 汇率 (exchange rate).

examples.zh: 我想给国外的朋友汇一些钱。
examples.en: I'd like to send some money to a friend abroad.

examples.zh: 银行说钱明天才能汇到。
examples.en: The bank said the money won't arrive until tomorrow.

examples.zh: 这条河在前面和大河汇在一起。
examples.en: This river joins a bigger river up ahead.

note: 投资收益 = investment return; also 有收益 = to be beneficial.

examples.zh: 这个项目的收益不错。
examples.en: The returns on this project are decent.

examples.zh: 今年公司的收益比去年高。
examples.en: The company's earnings are higher this year than last.

examples.zh: 他做的生意收益怎么样？
examples.en: How are the returns on his business?

note: Mostly an attributive word: 数码相机, 数码产品 (digital gadgets).

examples.zh: 我想买一台数码相机。
examples.en: I want to buy a digital camera.

examples.zh: 他很爱买各种数码产品。
examples.en: He loves buying all kinds of digital gadgets.

examples.zh: 这家店卖数码产品，价格不贵。
examples.en: This store sells digital products at reasonable prices.

note: 吃零食 = to eat snacks.

examples.zh: 我包里总有一些零食。
examples.en: There are always some snacks in my bag.

examples.zh: 吃太多零食对身体不好。
examples.en: Eating too many snacks is bad for your health.

examples.zh: 孩子在车上吃着零食。
examples.en: The kid is eating snacks in the car.

note: 定闹钟 = set an alarm; 闹钟响了 = the alarm went off.

examples.zh: 我昨天晚上忘了定闹钟。
examples.en: I forgot to set my alarm last night.

examples.zh: 闹钟响了，可是我没听见。
examples.en: The alarm went off, but I didn't hear it.

examples.zh: 明天要早点起床，请帮我定个闹钟。
examples.en: I have to get up early tomorrow; please set an alarm for me.

note: 国务院总理 = the Premier of China's State Council; 位 is the polite measure word.

examples.zh: 这位总理明天会来我们城市。
examples.en: The premier will visit our city tomorrow.

examples.zh: 新闻里说，总理见了很多外国客人。
examples.en: The news said the premier met many foreign guests.

examples.zh: 你知道现在的总理是谁吗？
examples.en: Do you know who the current premier is?

note: Often paired: 机遇和挑战 (opportunities and challenges). More formal than 机会.

examples.zh: 这是一个很好的机遇，你要去做。
examples.en: This is a great opportunity; you should go for it.

examples.zh: 中国的发展给很多人带来了机遇。
examples.en: China's development has brought opportunities to many people.

examples.zh: 年轻人要抓住机遇，也要努力。
examples.en: Young people should seize opportunities and also work hard.

meaning: generous; natural and at ease; tasteful

senses.en: generous; natural and at ease; tasteful

note: A trap: 大方 is not "big square"; it describes people (generous, poised) or style (tasteful).

examples.zh: 他对朋友很大方，常常请客。
examples.en: He is generous with friends and often treats them.

examples.zh: 她在很多人面前说话很大方。
examples.en: She speaks with ease in front of many people.

examples.zh: 这件衣服样子大方，颜色也好看。
examples.en: This piece of clothing has a tasteful style, and the color is nice too.

note: Written/formal for 夏天: used in forecasts, notices, and ads.

examples.zh: 夏季这里很热，常常下雨。
examples.en: In summer it is very hot here, with frequent rain.

examples.zh: 公司的夏季新产品下个月卖。
examples.en: The company's summer line goes on sale next month.

examples.zh: 今年夏季我打算去海边旅游。
examples.en: This summer I plan to travel to the seaside.

meaning: very few; just one or two; individual

senses.en: very few; just one or two; individual

note: 个别人 = a few individuals; implies exceptions, not the rule.

examples.zh: 只有个别同学没来上课。
examples.en: Only one or two students didn't come to class.

examples.zh: 这只是个别情况，不用担心。
examples.en: This is just an isolated case; don't worry.

examples.zh: 老师想和每个学生个别谈话。
examples.en: The teacher wants to talk with each student one on one.

note: Say 一百七十厘米 for 170 cm; 公分 is a common colloquial alternative.

examples.zh: 他有一百八十厘米高。
examples.en: He is 180 centimeters tall.

examples.zh: 这张桌子宽一百厘米，放得下吗？
examples.en: This table is 100 centimeters wide; will it fit?

examples.zh: 你的手机长多少厘米？
examples.en: How many centimeters long is your phone?
